title: Now who is that lankylooking galoot over there in the macintosh? Now who is he I’d like to know? Now I’d give a trifle to know who he is. Always someone turns up you never dreamt of.
html_source: First appearance of the man in the macintosh. An interesting theme of the book. Bloom had a glance of his creator.
